document_title: Comprehensive Physical Commissioning Acceptance Matrix (Gates C1 through C9)
acceptance_mandate: NO GATE MAY PASS BASED ON ARCHITECTURAL ASSUMPTIONS OR SYNTHETIC SIMULATION. Every gate requires on-site physical measurement, calibrated instrumentation, physical evidence artifacts, and signed operator certification.

commissioning_gates.requirement: IEEE 1588-2019 Grandmaster clock locked with >= 8 GNSS satellites; camera P99 offset <= 5.0 ms, CAN P99 offset <= 10.0 ms, secondary P99 offset <= 5.0 ms; composite multi-modal skew <= 33.33 ms.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope and Vector VN1640A CAN/PTP Interface
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: actual_composite_skew <= 33.33 ms AND all component offsets <= layer_a limits
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Abort commissioning; inspect GNSS antenna; check PTP priority and TSN switch queues.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Cameras A, B, C (and optional D) rigidly mounted (9.5 N*m torque); focus and aperture mechanically set-screwed; zero dropped frames over 30-min continuous ingest.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Norbar Calibrated Torque Wrench (1.0-20.0 N*m) + Wireshark Frame Loss Monitor
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: frame_drop_count == 0 over 30 min AND all mount torque == 9.5 N*m
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Re-tighten mounts; replace damaged Ethernet cables; optimize NIC ring buffer.

commissioning_gates.requirement: All MANDATORY_RAW_SIGNALS active, monotonic timestamps, continuous streaming (zero packet gaps > 20ms), SI units confirmed, steering_rate derivation verified.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Vector CANoe with VN1640A non-intrusive high-impedance CAN bus sniffer
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: can_packet_gap_max_ms <= 20.0 ms AND zero corrupt frames AND all mandatory signals active
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Verify CAN baud rate (500 kbps); inspect terminating resistor (120 Ohm); re-seat OBD/J1939 tap.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: Secondary Hazard Zone Physical Observability Proof
commissioning_gates.requirement: Physical reflective mannequin placed at 20.0m depth in cross-aisle; Camera C achieves >= 65 px/m resolution across mannequin torso; zero critical blind pockets (> 0.25 m^3).
commissioning_gates.instrument: Leica DISTO D2 Laser Measure + OpenCV target resolution validator
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Re-aim Camera C; adjust focal length; clear pallet rack overhangs; declare zone UNVERIFIED if blocked.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Multi-camera intrinsic reprojection error <= 1.5 px using 12x9 ChArUco diamond board; extrinsics registered to facility reference frame.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Certified Precision Aluminum ChArUco Calibration Target (Calib.io)
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: rms_reprojection_error_px <= 1.50 px across all deployed cameras
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Re-run calibration capture with 50+ diverse board angles; inspect lens distortion profile.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Total Station survey defining facility brass origin monument, floor ground plane (RMS error <= 3.0 mm), travel corridor boundaries, and exclusion zone perimeter.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Leica TS16 Total Station (1" angle accuracy, 1mm + 1.5ppm EDM)
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: ground_plane_rms_residual_mm <= 3.0 mm AND facility monument coordinates locked
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Re-survey ground plane targets; re-establish tie points; verify floor slab settlement.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Physical lux meter measurement across 5 corridor points confirming mean illuminance within CURRENT_ACCEPTANCE_TARGET (350 +/- 50 lux) with zero flicker banding.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Testo 540 Digital Lux Meter / GOSSEN MAVOLUX 5032B
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Adjust warehouse luminaire dimmers; replace faulty LED ballast drivers; install diffuser panels.

commissioning_gates.gate_name: E-Stop Safety Circuit & Traction Cutoff Latency Acceptance
commissioning_gates.requirement: Wireless remote E-Stop certified Cat 4 / SIL-3 by notified body; empirical digital oscilloscope trace proves traction motor power disconnect <= 50.0 ms upon switch actuation.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope connected to E-Stop contactor auxiliary contacts
commissioning_gates.acceptance_rule: measured_cutoff_latency_ms <= 50.0 ms AND vendor Cat 4 / SIL-3 certificate on file
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Inspect emergency contactor coil spring; replace slow auxiliary relay; reject uncertified hardware.

commissioning_gates.requirement: Formal signed Data Agreement between Research Consortium, Facility Management, and Labor Safety Representatives; hardware microphones physically disconnected on all cameras.
commissioning_gates.instrument: Visual hardware inspection + cryptographic document ledger
commissioning_gates.failure_action: Physical desoldering/jumpers of camera microphone traces; halt all capture until agreement signed.
